evals.prompt: عندي مقابلة الأسبوع القادم لوظيفة مطور backend في شركة تقنية ناشئة. أنا شغال على Python وDjango من 3 سنين. ساعدني أتمرن
evals.expected_output: The skill greets the user in Arabic, asks for more details about the job and their CV/profile, then runs a structured interview covering soft skills, technical Python/Django questions, and a practical coding challenge. Ends with a detailed Arabic dashboard with CV score, interview performance ratings, verdict, and actionable tips.

assertions.name: responds_in_arabic
assertions.description: The response is primarily in Arabic

assertions.name: asks_for_cv_or_profile
assertions.description: Asks for CV, LinkedIn, or profile information before starting the interview

assertions.name: asks_one_question_at_a_time
assertions.description: During the interview phase, asks only one question per turn

assertions.name: includes_technical_coding_question
assertions.description: Includes at least one practical coding/technical question relevant to Python or Django

assertions.name: produces_dashboard_with_verdict
assertions.description: Produces a final dashboard with a clear verdict (مقبول / مقبول بشروط / بحاجة لتطوير) and scores

assertions.name: includes_cv_matching_score
assertions.description: The dashboard includes a CV/profile matching percentage score

assertions.name: includes_actionable_tips
assertions.description: Provides at least 5 specific, actionable improvement tips at the end

evals.prompt: I have a job interview for a Digital Marketing Manager role at a Saudi e-commerce company next Thursday. My background: 5 years in social media marketing, worked with brands like Noon and Jarir. Can you do a mock interview with me? I prefer English.
evals.expected_output: Skill switches to English since user requested it, asks for CV/profile link, then conducts a structured interview with soft skill questions, marketing strategy questions, and practical scenario-based questions (e.g., designing a campaign, handling a PR crisis). Ends with a full English dashboard with CV score, interview ratings, verdict, and specific tips.

assertions.name: switches_to_english
assertions.description: Detects user preference and responds entirely in English

assertions.name: asks_for_profile_info
assertions.description: Requests CV, portfolio, or LinkedIn before starting

assertions.name: includes_marketing_practical_question
assertions.description: Asks at least one practical marketing scenario question (campaign design, budget allocation, crisis management, etc.)

assertions.name: maintains_neutral_tone_during_interview
assertions.description: Does not give positive or negative feedback after each answer during the interview phase

assertions.name: produces_dashboard_with_verdict
assertions.description: Produces a comprehensive dashboard with verdict, scores per category, and CV matching score

assertions.name: tips_are_role_specific
assertions.description: The improvement tips are specific to digital marketing, not generic career advice

evals.prompt: أبغى أتمرن على مقابلة وظيفة محلل بيانات في بنك. عندي بكالوريوس إحصاء وشهادة في Python for Data Science من Coursera. ما عندي خبرة عملية كثير — سنة بس internship. ساعدني
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges the junior profile, asks for more details, runs a structured interview adapted to entry-level expectations but still covering soft skills, data analysis concepts, and a practical data scenario question. Honest CV feedback noting the gap between the degree and job requirements, a fair matching score, constructive verdict, and detailed tips specifically tailored to a fresh graduate entering data roles in a bank.

assertions.name: adapts_to_junior_level
assertions.description: Adjusts question difficulty and expectations for an entry-level/internship-level candidate

assertions.name: includes_data_practical_question
assertions.description: Asks at least one practical data analysis scenario (data cleaning, model selection, result interpretation, etc.)

assertions.name: honest_about_experience_gap
assertions.description: Honestly addresses the limited experience in the CV feedback and matching score

assertions.name: produces_dashboard_with_verdict
assertions.description: Ends with a full dashboard including verdict, per-category scores, matching percentage, and tips

assertions.name: tips_include_learning_resources
assertions.description: Tips include at least one specific learning resource (course, book, certification) relevant to data analyst roles in banking
